resources.string: Pick your wallet. It opens inside the wallet app — sign once and you’re connected. Signing isn’t a transaction and costs nothing.
One wallet links to one STEPUP account. The request is valid for 10 minutes.
Copies the link — paste it in Rabby’s browser
Tap “Connect wallet” on the page that opened in %1$s, then sign. Come back here when you’re done.
We copied the link. In %1$s, paste it into the browser’s address bar, open it, tap “Connect wallet” and sign. Then come back here.
Not connected yet. Finish signing in %1$s, then check again.
